name: meta-pytorch/dist_moe
title: Meta open-sources Dist-MoE fused communication and compute kernels for MoE training and inference
summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Dist-MoE, fused communication and compute kernels for mixture-of-experts layers with full CUDA graph support, BF16 and MXFP8 training and NVFP4 inference on SM100+ GPUs. On GB300 NVL72 they report up to 1.40x over Mixture-of-Kittens on an imbalanced MXFP8 training workload and about 3.09 useful PFLOP/s per GPU for NVFP4 inference; PyTorch's ezyang says it solve
